sections.heading: Research
sections.intro: My research concerns the evaluation and security of AI systems that handle financial data. The current programme is a series of three studies on a single domain, the financial records of a goods distributor, comprising statements, invoices and payments. Each study is published as a technical report with its evaluation data, cost per run, latency figures and documented failure modes, together with the code required to reproduce the results.

paper.statusBody: Status: {status}. This paper sets out the design of the study. The evaluation results, the dataset and the code required to reproduce them will be published here when the study is complete. No results are reported until they have been measured.
paper.repositoryPending: The repository will be published with the results.
